subject: english
question:
From the alternatives given below, select the correct passive voice of the following sentence.

The nuns have to leave the door of the church open for all the parishioners to get in.

options.text: The door of the church has been left open by the nuns for all the parishioners to get in.
The door of the church has to be left open by the nuns for all the parishioners to get in.
The door of the church has to be left opened by the nuns for all the parishioners to get in.
The door of the church has to be left open for all the parishioners by the nuns to get in.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
